vectors.name: empty-input
vectors.why: The empty string must decode to zero segments, zero counts and an empty payload, so a runner cannot pass by accident.

vectors.name: plain-ascii
vectors.why: Plain ASCII is entirely visible and nothing in it is counted.
vectors.input: Push the fix once CI is green.

expect.visible: Push the fix once CI is green.

vectors.name: visible-non-ascii
vectors.why: A non ASCII letter and an astral emoji stay visible and count as nothing, proving iteration is by code point and a surrogate pair is one character, not two.

vectors.name: tag-start-alone
vectors.why: U+E0000 is inside the tag block, so it is counted, but the strict payload guard makes it a no op that contributes nothing.

vectors.name: tag-start-embedded
vectors.why: U+E0000 between visible letters is counted as a tag and renders as its U+E0000 spelling, and the payload stays empty.

vectors.name: tag-end-alone
vectors.why: U+E007F is also inside the tag block, so it is counted and decodes to nothing.

vectors.name: tag-end-embedded
vectors.why: U+E007F between visible letters is counted as a tag, contributes nothing to the payload, and renders as its own spelling.

vectors.name: tag-noop-boundaries-bracket-payload
vectors.why: Real payload characters on both sides of U+E0000 and U+E007F survive intact in the payload while the two no ops are counted but skipped.

vectors.name: tag-payload-sentence
vectors.why: A full tag block payload decodes back to readable ASCII in one hidden run inside visible text.

vectors.name: tag-two-runs-split-by-visible
vectors.why: Two hidden runs separated by visible text merge in the payload while the segments keep the visible run between them.

vectors.name: bidi-all-twelve
vectors.why: All twelve bidi control code points the decoder names, adjacent so they land in one hidden segment, each counted and spelled as hex.

vectors.name: bidi-override-202e-alone
vectors.why: U+202E alone, the bidi override the site's own copy calls out, is counted as bidi and renders as hex, with an empty payload.

vectors.name: bidi-override-in-a-word
vectors.why: A U+202E dropped inside a visible word splits it into two visible segments around one hidden hex token.

vectors.name: vs-plain-block-bounds
vectors.why: U+FE00 and U+FE0F, the first and last variation selectors of the BMP block, are both counted as variation selectors and nothing else.

vectors.name: vs-supplementary-block-bounds
vectors.why: U+E0100 and U+E01EF, the first and last variation selectors of the supplementary block, are both counted, proving the astral bounds are inclusive.

vectors.name: vs-emoji-realistic
vectors.why: A real FE0F attached to an emoji is counted as a variation selector while the emoji itself stays visible.

vectors.name: near-miss-bidi-adjacent
vectors.why: U+061B, U+2010, U+2065 and U+206A neighbour the bidi controls without being any of them, so all four must stay visible and uncounted.

vectors.name: near-miss-zwj-and-bom
vectors.why: U+200D sits between the counted U+200E and U+200F and U+FEFF sits just past the variation selector block, so neither may be counted.

vectors.name: near-miss-vs-adjacent
vectors.why: U+FDFF just below and U+FE10 just above the BMP variation selector block are ordinary visible characters.

vectors.name: near-miss-tag-adjacent
vectors.why: U+E0080 and U+E00FF fall outside the tag block and U+E01F0 and U+E01FF fall outside the supplementary selector block, so all four stay visible and uncounted.

vectors.name: mixed-all-three-classes
vectors.why: A bidi override, a tag block payload and a variation selector in one input are counted in their own buckets and concatenated into one payload.

vectors.name: site-sample-payload
vectors.why: The page's own demo text, pinned end to end: its 59 tag code points decode to the sample injection string and nothing else in it is hidden.
